title: Complete Soul Factory publication on the first accepted relay
intent: A verified NIP-01 OK accepted=true from any configured relay satisfies Soul Factory publication quorum. An unhealthy secondary relay must not stall provisioning after another relay accepts the event.
scope: Soul Factory progress, result, soul, and lifecycle event publication
non_goals: Treating send completion as relay acceptance
Requiring every configured relay to accept duplicate copies
Replaying more than the newest stored request/action during restart recovery
